tasks.task: Find the wiki page of ohmyzsh on GitHub and tell me how to change the theme of zsh to agnoster.
tasks.answer: To change the zsh theme to agnoster with Oh My Zsh (per the Oh My Zsh wiki at github.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/wiki, Themes page): 1) Open your ~/.zshrc file in a text editor. 2) Find the ZSH_THEME setting and change it to ZSH_THEME="agnoster". 3) Save the file and reload the configuration with 'source ~/.zshrc' (or open a new terminal). Note: the agnoster theme uses special glyphs, so a Powerline-compatible font is recommended.
